description: Export the document as an e-book (EPUB) to path (a .epub file; an existing file only with overwrite true, otherwise io_error with details.code file_exists). layout is required: reflowable (text reflows to the reader's screen and font size; for text-led books) or fixed_layout (every page keeps its layout; for picture books, comics, heavily designed pages). Options apply to this call only and are restored afterwards: epub_version 2 or 3 (reflowable; fixed layout is always EPUB 3), cover none | first_page | image (with cover_image_path, a JPEG, PNG or GIF that must exist), toc_style (an existing TOC style, see list_toc_styles and define_toc_style – it builds the EPUB navigation; without it the navigation lists only file names), image_resolution 72 | 96 | 150 | 300 ppi, image_format automatic | jpeg | png | gif, jpeg_quality low | medium | high | maximum; reflowable only: export_order layout | articles | xml, split_by_paragraph_style (start a new file at each paragraph of this style, e.g. chapter headings), embed_fonts; fixed layout only: page_range (printed page names like export_pdf), spread_control document | physical | synthetic | none, orientation portrait | landscape | auto (InDesign itself writes landscape even for upright pages, which locks reading apps to landscape; the server therefore sets the orientation in the finished file – by default from the page format – and returns orientation_set {value, previous, changed}). metadata {title, creator, publisher, description, subject, rights, date, identifier} goes into the package (an identifier such as urn:isbn:… is added next to InDesign's own unique id); the EPUB language comes from the document's default language (text defaults), not from a parameter. Returns path, bytes, overwritten, layout, settings_used (the values InDesign exported with), document_language, settings_changed_for_export and document_marked_modified – InDesign marks the document as modified whenever an export setting is set, although the settings are restored; close without saving if nothing else changed. warnings[] name missing title or creator, a missing default language, no TOC style, no cover, objects not anchored in the text flow (reflowable) and fonts that cannot be embedded. Check the document before with check_epub and the file after with check_epub path; for print use export_pdf, for page images export_page_image. Can take minutes on a long book.

cover.description: Cover inside the EPUB. Default: as set in the document.

cover_image_path.description: Cover image file (JPEG, PNG or GIF) for cover image.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

epub_version.description: EPUB version for reflowable export. Default: as set in the document.

export_order.description: Reflowable: content order – layout, Articles panel or XML structure.

identifier.description: E.g. urn:isbn:… – added as a second dc:identifier.

orientation.description: Fixed layout: reading orientation written into the EPUB (rendition:orientation). Default: from the page format – portrait for upright pages, landscape for wide pages, auto for square pages.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing file at path. Default false.

page_range.description: Fixed layout: pages to export by printed page name, e.g. "1-12".

path.description: Required. Target .epub path on the machine running InDesign.

split_by_paragraph_style.description: Reflowable: start a new content file at every paragraph of this paragraph style.

spread_control.description: Fixed layout: spreads as in the document, physical, synthetic or none.

toc_style.description: Existing TOC style that builds the EPUB navigation.

name: export_epub
title: Export as EPUB
